title: Login form allows duplicate submissions while authentication is pending
reasoning: handleSubmit starts an async login request but the component does not track pending state or disable the submit button. Repeated clicks or Enter submissions before the first request settles can issue multiple login calls and potentially race setAuth/navigate/error handling. The tests cover a single successful submit but do not assert duplicate-click behavior while the login promise is unresolved.
reproduction: Mock login to return a never-resolving promise, fill the form, and click the Login button twice; login will be called twice.
recommendation: Add an isPending state or use a mutation abstraction, disable the submit button while pending, and ignore submit events while a login request is in flight.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: LoginForm tests cover success, failure, and input validation attributes, but none keep the login promise pending and attempt a second submit.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a LoginForm test that uses a controlled pending login promise, double-clicks the submit button, and expects login to have been called exactly once and the button to be disabled during the pending state.
minimumFixScope: Update LoginForm to gate duplicate submits and add the pending-state regression test.
